listenings.text: Hi Rodrigo, it's Tom. I got your message about the broken machine. Good news: we have the spare part here in New Jersey. I'll send it today by air, so it will arrive in Sao Paulo on Wednesday. I'll email you the tracking number in one hour. Don't worry, it won't be late.

Hi Rodrigo, it's Nora. Your hotel in New York is confirmed. I'll send you the address today. On your first day, I'll meet you in the lobby at nine, and we'll walk to the office together. It's only ten minutes. Don't worry, it will be easy!

extra_audio.text: On Monday, a machine at the plant was broken. Claire needed samples for a client in Paris. Rodrigo said: I'll call the maintenance team right away. Tom sent the spare part from New Jersey. The samples were ready on Friday, and they weren't late.
